description: Build landing page with marketing content including hero section, how-it-works steps, feature showcase, template gallery, FAQ accordion, and footer. This is an independent feature that can be developed in parallel with FEAT-004. Creates src/components/landing/* components and updates Home page to display them.
steps: Create src/components/landing/Hero.tsx: FC component displaying hero section with headline 'Build Your Professional Portfolio in Minutes', subheadline 'Create a stunning digital portfolio, publish with a permanent URL, and share via QR code. No coding skills required.', two CTA buttons ('Create Your Portfolio' → /register, 'Explore Examples' → demo portfolio), optional hero image or gradient background.

Create src/components/landing/HowItWorks.tsx: FC component with 4-step vertical layout. Each step: icon (from lucide-react), number, title, description. Steps: (1) Sign up with email, (2) Fill portfolio info, (3) Choose template & customize, (4) Publish & share QR code. Responsive: vertical on mobile, horizontal on desktop.

Create src/components/landing/Features.tsx: FC component displaying 5-6 feature cards in grid (3 per row on desktop, 1 per row on mobile). Each card: icon, title, description. Features: multi-section portfolio builder, three templates, QR code generation, mobile-responsive, private/published control, easy updates.

Create src/components/landing/TemplateGallery.tsx: FC component displaying 3 template cards side-by-side (responsive). Each card: template preview image (or styled div placeholder), template name (Minimal Professional, Modern Developer, Creative Portfolio), 'Use Template' button linking to registration. Short description per template.

Create src/components/landing/FAQ.tsx: FC component with accordion list (8-10 questions). Questions from design spec: Is StudentFolio free? Do I need coding knowledge? Can I update after publishing? Is my data private? Can I delete my account? What if I don't have projects? Can I add sections later? What are file size limits? For each question: clickable header that toggles answer display.

Create src/components/landing/Footer.tsx: FC component displaying footer with: company name/logo, brief description, links (Home, Privacy, Terms, GitHub), social icons, copyright text, and centered CTA button 'Get Started Free' → /register. Responsive layout.
Update src/pages/Home.tsx to import and render: Hero → HowItWorks → Features → TemplateGallery → FAQ → Footer. Ensure full page scrolls through all sections.
Verify responsive design on mobile (375px), tablet (768px), desktop (1920px) using browser dev tools or responsive testing.
acceptance_criteria: Landing page loads at / without errors
Hero section displays headline, subheadline, and two CTA buttons that navigate correctly
HowItWorks section shows 4 steps with icons, readable on mobile and desktop
Features section displays 6 cards in responsive grid (3 per row on desktop, 1 on mobile)
TemplateGallery shows 3 template cards with preview images and working CTA buttons
FAQ accordion expands/collapses on click; all 8-10 questions and answers visible
Footer renders at bottom with all links, social icons, copyright, and CTA button
All links in landing page navigate to correct routes (/register, /login, etc.)
Page is fully responsive: readable and functional at 375px, 768px, 1920px widths
All images/icons load correctly (use Lucide icons for consistency)
verification: Run `npm run dev` → navigate to http://localhost:5173 → expect landing page displays with all sections
Test Hero CTA buttons: click 'Create Your Portfolio' → expect redirect to /register; click 'Explore Examples' → expect navigation to demo portfolio
Test HowItWorks: view on mobile (375px viewport) → expect vertical layout; view on desktop → expect cleaner layout
Test Features: verify all 6 cards display; verify grid changes from 3-col (desktop) to 1-col (mobile)
Test TemplateGallery: verify 3 templates visible; click 'Use Template' → expect navigation to /register with template pre-selected (future enhancement)
Test FAQ: click question header → expect answer expands; click again → expect collapses
Test Footer: verify all links are clickable; click CTA button → expect /register
Test responsive: use browser dev tools to test viewport sizes 375px, 768px, 1920px → expect page readable and functional at each size
Run `npm run build` → expect build succeeds, landing page bundled correctly
findings: All 6 landing components built: Hero with dual CTAs, HowItWorks with 4 vertical/responsive steps, Features with 6 responsive grid cards, TemplateGallery with 3 template cards, FAQ with 10-item accordion, Footer with social/links/CTA. Home page renders all sections in sequence. Fully responsive at 375px, 768px, 1920px viewports. Build succeeds without errors. All links functional (CTAs navigate to /register, /login, /dashboard). Lucide icons used throughout for consistency. Tailwind CSS with design spec colors (teal-400 accent, slate-800/900 backgrounds). Accordion expands/collapses on click. Components follow existing patterns (Card, Button components reused).
